BETA Close X Card Factory PLC has announced the purchase of 551,779 of its ordinary shares between May 11th and May 15th, 2026, through UBS AG London Branch, with these shares to be cancelled. The purchases occurred at prices ranging from 65.60 pence to 70.00 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company's issued ordinary share capital stands at 350,266,853 shares, with 5,278,902 held in treasury, leaving 344,987,951 shares for shareholder notification calculations. Disclaimer* Card Factory PLC 18 May 2026 18 May 2026 'Card Factory plc (the "Company") Transactions in own shares Card Factory plc, the UK's leading specialist retailer of greeting cards, gifts and celebration essentials, announces that it purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 pence each in the capital of the Company ('Ordinary Shares') through UBS AG London Branch. The Ordinary Shares purchased will be cancelled. Date of purchase: 11 May 2026 12 May 2026 13 May 2026 14 May 2026 15 May 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 87,564 93,233 50,505 100,975 121,572 Highest price paid per share (pence per share): 68.40 66.90 66.40 70.00 67.90 Lowest price paid per share (pence per share): 67.00 65.70 65.60 66.90 66.50 Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share): 67.7704 66.1878 66.1491 68.2159 67.2672 The Company notifies the market that at the date of this announcement the Company's issued ordinary share capital comprises 350,266,853 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1p each ("Ordinary Shares") with each share carrying one vote. In aggregate, 5,278,902 Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. The number of 344,987,951 ordinary shares may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change in their interest in, the ordinary share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
